content:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary failure detected for /v2/streaming-generate in eu-west-1 — 18x 502s in 2m, error rate > abort threshold.
alex: ack. I'm the oncall, paging in. Watching dashboards now.
priya: saw it on datadog, spike correlates with requests hitting model-shard-3. Timeouts when opening stream socket.
jamal: logs from proxy show repeated 'upstream connect timeout' to 10.12.3.9:3200
selena: if we can flip the streaming-v2 flag to off we can route back to streaming-v1. Recommend quickstop.
alex: on it. running ffctl
alex: ```
# toggle streaming-v2 off
ffctl set streaming-v2 enabled=false --env=prod --reason "canary 502 spike"
``` 
ops-bot: feature-flag-service: streaming-v2 set to false (req 4529). Traffic shift starting.
incident-bot: Abort criteria met: canary rollout aborted and traffic steering reverted to stable.
jamal: also seeing edge proxies in eu-west 5xx -> envoy shows route pointing to pod set 'canary'. possible connectivity regression from canary pool.
priya: I'll roll back the streaming-backend deployment to previous revision
priya: ```
kubectl -n platform rollout undo deployment/streaming-backend --to-revision=5
``` 
alex: rollback triggered, watching until 95th pct recovers.
selena: support queue: 4 customers reported 502s (SUP-4521, SUP-4523, SUP-4524, SUP-4527). Minimal but need status page.
dave: drafting status: "We are investigating 5xx errors affecting a subset of streaming API requests in eu-west-1. Traffic has been reverted to a stable variant; engineers are monitoring." want me to publish?
alex: yes publish and ping @support. Handing off to @oncall-next (selena) for post-mitigation triage and RCA lead.
oncall-next: ack taking over. I'll gather traces, hop into shard host (10.12.3.9) and check socket counts.
selena: quick curl to streaming endpoint during spike attached:
selena: ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" "https://api.redwood.ai/v2/streaming-generate" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# -> * Connection timed out after 2001 ms
# -> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```
ops-bot: pagerduty: incident acknowledged by alex. monitoring continues.
alex: leaving channel — oncall handoff complete. selena, take over. :white_check_mark:
selena: will run thorough traces and open a postmortem if we see regression after rollback.
